description: This Go source file defines the implementation of an operation management system within the 'orchestrator' package for handling asynchronous operations, including creation, retrieval, completion, listing, and waiting for operations to complete. It specifically implements a Map-based OperationManager and relevant error types

classes.name: mapOMOperationEntry
classes.description: Internal data structure representing an individual operation, its result, synchronization primitives, and status

classes.name: MapOM
classes.description: Implementation of the OperationManager interface based on a map of operation entries, providing thread-safe operations for managing asynchronous tasks

methods.name: NewMapOM
methods.description: Constructor function that creates and returns a new instance of MapOM

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new operation with a generated UUID, registers it, and returns the corresponding Operation object

methods.name: ListRunning
methods.description: Returns a list of all currently running (not done) operations

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an operation by name, returns error if not found

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Provides the result of a completed operation; errors if operation is not found or not yet done

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks an operation as completed and records its result

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until the specified operation is complete or the timeout expires
